column3: “the things” renders “the words,” and NASB supplies “you.”
“a sabbath of complete rest” renders “a sabbath of sabbath observance (shabbaton).”
“porpoise skins” renders “tahash skins,” an animal whose identity is uncertain.
“every skillful man” renders “every wise of heart.”
“the mercy seat” renders “kapporet,” the atonement cover.
“the bread of the Presence” renders “the bread of the face.”
“the woven garments” renders “garments of serad,” a word whose meaning is uncertain.
“whose heart stirred him” renders “whose heart lifted him.”
“whose hearts moved them” renders “willing of heart,” and “presented an offering” renders “waved a wave offering”; “brooches” and “bracelets” render ornaments whose identity is uncertain.
“the skilled women” renders “every woman wise of heart.”
“whose heart stirred with a skill” renders “whose heart lifted them in wisdom.”
